lines.t: No auto-tunes, no fake crowns, truth talk only
Came from the dirt where the wolves all grin
Faith thrown stack but the soul stay thin
They flex for the net, I bow to the throne
You chase the bag, I walk alone
Never loud with it, never flashy speech
Truth moves silent till it got a preach
Steel in the spine, peace in the eyes
Don't need a crowd when the call come down from the sky
I don't move till he say move
Don't speak till he say speak
Low walk, head bowed
But the word hit hard when it reach
Man of God, no disguise
Man of God, no lies
Man of God, no lies
Man of God, no lies
Seen kings fall for a moment of fame
Sell a soul just to like their name
I'd rather wait in the shadows alone
Than rush ahead where he ain't shown
Not my will, not my plan
I don't run unless sent by his hand
Quiet steps but the ground still shake
When heaven speak, decisions break
Patience louder than a loaded gun
Obedience heavier than what I've done
You want power, learn how to wait
You want truth, learn how to obey
Your religion no clout chase
Commandments live, not a costume face
World too loud, spirit too numb, but the call stay clear when the kingdom come
Don't ask why I ain't in the mix, I don't drink poison just to feel legit
Set apart, cut different, chosen don't blend, they walks up minute in
A man of God is humble and quiet, until called upon to speak
A man of low degree who treads, softly until called upon to act
A lonely man who is, completely in love with me
Who does not his own will
Nor seek his own way
A man who waits upon the Lord
And hesitates not when the command
Comes down from the mouth
Of the Lord his God
A man after my own heart
My servant, my friend
Says the Lord
Thank you.
